title: USB Loader NX Manager theme
description: theme.json of a Manager theme; generated from theme-spec.json. Every value is a string.

Name.description: Shown in the theme picker (the folder name otherwise)

Author.description: Shown in the theme picker as "by …"

Version.description: The theme's own version, whatever its author likes
The version of this format the theme was made for

Thumbnail.description: The preview in the theme picker (16:9, 320x180 is enough); without it `thumb.png`, `thumb.jpg`, then the background are tried, and with none of them the picker sketches the screen in the theme's colors

Background.description: Drawn behind everything, over the `Ground` color. An animated GIF or WebP plays in a loop: up to 1280x720, 30 frames a second at most and 32 MB; WebP looks better and weighs less than GIF (256 colors)

BackgroundMode.description: How the background fills the screen

BackgroundDim.description: How much of `Ground` covers the background image so text stays readable; over an image, the text areas also get a veil of `Ground`

Panel.description: PNGs in place of windows, cards (and the focused one), the small chips, buttons (and the one A presses) and the focus ring; stretched in nine slices, so their corners keep their size

Card.description: PNGs in place of windows, cards (and the focused one), the small chips, buttons (and the one A presses) and the focus ring; stretched in nine slices, so their corners keep their size

CardFocused.description: PNGs in place of windows, cards (and the focused one), the small chips, buttons (and the one A presses) and the focus ring; stretched in nine slices, so their corners keep their size

Chip.description: PNGs in place of windows, cards (and the focused one), the small chips, buttons (and the one A presses) and the focus ring; stretched in nine slices, so their corners keep their size

Button.description: PNGs in place of windows, cards (and the focused one), the small chips, buttons (and the one A presses) and the focus ring; stretched in nine slices, so their corners keep their size

ButtonActive.description: PNGs in place of windows, cards (and the focused one), the small chips, buttons (and the one A presses) and the focus ring; stretched in nine slices, so their corners keep their size

FocusRing.description: PNGs in place of windows, cards (and the focused one), the small chips, buttons (and the one A presses) and the focus ring; stretched in nine slices, so their corners keep their size

PanelBorder.description: How wide those corners are, in the image's px

CardBorder.description: How wide those corners are, in the image's px

CardFocusedBorder.description: How wide those corners are, in the image's px

ChipBorder.description: How wide those corners are, in the image's px

ButtonBorder.description: How wide those corners are, in the image's px

ButtonActiveBorder.description: How wide those corners are, in the image's px

FocusRingBorder.description: How wide those corners are, in the image's px

Usb.description: PNGs in place of the built-in icons

Clock.description: PNGs in place of the built-in icons

Warning.description: PNGs in place of the built-in icons

Chevron.description: PNGs in place of the built-in icons

Star.description: PNGs in place of the built-in icons

Package.description: PNGs in place of the built-in icons

Grid.description: PNGs in place of the built-in icons

IconTint.description: `on`: icons and the focus ring image take the color they are drawn in (draw them white); otherwise they keep their own

GameBackdrop.description: The selected game's cover or icon, blurred, behind the home screen (the player can turn it off too); on by default unless the theme has its own `Images.Background`

Regular.description: A TTF or OTF (up to 16 MB) for all the text; letters it lacks (other scripts, button glyphs) come from the console's font

Scale.description: The font's size against the console's

Music.description: Background music, under the sound effects; the player can turn it off in the settings

Speed.description: How fast transitions run (`1` as designed)

Easing.description: How transitions move (`out-back` goes a little past and settles, `out-elastic` springs)

FocusPulse.description: Seconds for the focus ring to go from `Focus` to `FocusAlt` and back; `off` keeps it still

Edge.description: The margin at the left and right

Y.description: The bar's distance from the top

Visible.description: The drives' free space on the toolbar
The button hints at the bottom

Home.description: Components of the Home screen: logo, title, chip.filter, chip.sort, chip.search, chip.drives, info.drive, info.name, info.chips, info.stats, info.alert, button.launch, button.details, counter, hints, or any other name with a Type.

Game.description: Components of the Game screen: window, cover, title, details, button.launch, button.hide, or any other name with a Type.

Drives.description: Components of the Drives screen: window, title, total, cards, or any other name with a Type.

Settings.description: Components of the Settings screen: title, sections, content, or any other name with a Type.

Arc.description: How much lower (or higher) the last cover sits, along a curve (`0`, a straight shelf)

Scale.description: Each next cover this much the size of the one before

Columns.description: Columns of the grid (the Covers view has two more)

Enabled.description: The views the theme offers, comma separated (`boxes` is the Cover Flow)

Default.description: The view to start in when the player has not picked one

Ground.description: Screen background, and the gap between a focused item and its ring

Raised.description: Selected cards and sections, cards inside windows

Track.description: Lines, borders, empty bars, switches turned off

Text.description: Text and button glyphs, and softer text and icons

TextSoft.description: Text and button glyphs, and softer text and icons

Muted.description: Secondary text, from strongest to faintest

MutedSoft.description: Secondary text, from strongest to faintest

Faint.description: Secondary text, from strongest to faintest

Primary.description: The app mark, the main buttons, switches turned on

Focus.description: The focus ring pulses between the two, with a glow

FocusAlt.description: The focus ring pulses between the two, with a glow

Warning.description: With `Primary`, the drive usage bar: `Primary` up to 60%, then these up to 100%

Pending.description: With `Primary`, the drive usage bar: `Primary` up to 60%, then these up to 100%

Error.description: With `Primary`, the drive usage bar: `Primary` up to 60%, then these up to 100%

Alert.description: What needs attention: an update on another drive, fragmentation (line, box, box text)

AlertSurface.description: What needs attention: an update on another drive, fragmentation (line, box, box text)

AlertText.description: What needs attention: an update on another drive, fragmentation (line, box, box text)

Overlay.description: Over the screen behind a window (use `#RRGGBBAA`)

Anchor.description: The screen's point the component's own same point sits at

X.description: The offset from that point (without `Anchor`, from the screen's top left); without `X`, `Y` or `Anchor` the component stays where the Manager puts it

Align.description: The text within the component's width

Type.description: Makes it a component of the theme's own (see the types)

Color.description: The text color of `clock`, `battery` and `text` (`Text` by default)
